description_en: Queries the IP or VPC whitelist of an instance. Only new-architecture instances are supported, that is, instances whose VPC access point (or VPC PrivateLink access point) ends with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com
description_zh:
查询实例ip/vpc白名单；
只支持新架构实例，即VPC接入点（或者VPC PrivateLink 接入点）以mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com结尾的实例
name: ListInstanceWhiteList

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance whose whitelist you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询白名单的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The whitelist type. If WhiteListItem contains an IP address, set WhiteListType to 2. If WhiteListItem contains a VPC ID, set WhiteListType to 1.

The VPC whitelist applies only to instances whose VPC access point is of the anytunnel type. The VPC access point of the latest version instances is of the privateLink type. Therefore, you cannot configure a VPC whitelist for such instances
parameters.help_zh:
白名单类型。
如果WhiteListItem中是IP类型，WhiteListType设置为2；如果WhiteListItem中设置vpcId，则WhiteListType设置1。

vpc白名单仅针对vpc接入点是anytunnel类型的实例。最新版本实例vpc接入点为privateLink类型，因此不能针对此种类型实例设置vpc白名单
parameters.name: white_list_type
